radiusSource: Radius 91.9 +/- 30.9 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, BM Per: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 91.9 +/- 30.9 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 63,934,830 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
